pornographic_and_vulgar.definition: Explicit sexual behavior or meaning, or the reviewed strict exposure boundary of more than half of breasts or buttocks visibly exposed.
positive_signals: explicit sexual behavior, sexual act implication, or explicit sexual meaning
more than half of breasts or buttocks visibly exposed
false_positive_boundaries: romantic intimacy, affectionate behavior, or affectionate or obsession perfume copy without an explicit sexual cue
ordinary lingerie, lace, fitness wear, back exposure, legs, body curves, or attractive posing without an explicit sexual cue
clothing transparency or a sexualized impression alone is insufficient
normal model, apparel, swimwear, or underwear display without explicit sexual behavior or meaning
evidence_requirements: at least one visible CONTENT image

disgusting_and_terrifying.definition: Strong visible disgust, filth, bodily abnormality, waste, grotesque close-up, dense insects, sewer-like dirt, or terrifying imagery.
positive_signals: severe decayed or dirty teeth close-up
wound or disturbing body close-up
excrement, visibly filthy liquid, dirty toilet, or sewer
dense insect or clear horror imagery
gross-out visual used in a cleaning-product demonstration
false_positive_boundaries: ordinary cleaning scene
mild dust or dirt
normal product-use process
merely unattractive visual
evidence_requirements: at least one visible CONTENT image
no audio evidence

irrelevant_promotion.definition: CONTENT_1 is clearly and completely unrelated to the promoted product after considering both visible visual and text evidence.
positive_signals: an unrelated meme, chat screenshot, emotional or lifestyle scene, person image, landscape, or narrative setup leads into a completely unrelated product promotion
false_positive_boundaries: any visible product or relevant use scene blocks the hit
a matching motif, direct product discussion, or any reasonable semantic bridge blocks the hit
do not hit merely because CONTENT_1 is creative, narrative, lifestyle oriented, or does not show a packshot
evidence_requirements: CONTENT_1 visible
at least one visible PRODUCT image
consider both visual and text evidence before declaring complete irrelevance

content_product_mismatch.definition: A clear core contradiction between the promoted CONTENT and bound PRODUCT references that changes what the buyer expects to receive or experience.
positive_signals: physical product identity or core category conflict
primary function or sellable mechanism conflict
product form, included components, or visible quantity conflict
material size, dimension, capacity, or key specification conflict
promised use or core visual effect conflict
material brand or product line identity conflict when it defines buyer expectation
false_positive_boundaries: color only differences
minor style, texture, material, or accessory differences
lighting, angle, crop, composition, or background differences
packaging language or incidental brand text
a brief prop or opening element
different variants that remain compatible with the sold set
weak, ambiguous, or partially hidden comparisons
evidence_requirements: at least one visible CONTENT evidence item
at least one visible PRODUCT evidence item
name the core difference dimension
explain why the difference changes buyer expectation

misleading_function_and_effect.definition: A concrete claim or visual demonstration in CONTENT presents a clearly false, exaggerated, or unsupported function or result.
positive_signals: large concrete result claimed in an extremely short time
before and after frames show an implausible claimed result while surrounding pixels remain materially identical
CONTENT demonstrates a concrete function contradicted by visible reference or packaging evidence
false_positive_boundaries: PRODUCT images alone cannot independently trigger this issue
ordinary advertising tone or subjective praise
absolute sounding copy without a concrete false result
claims compatible with the product
normal effect demonstration, reasonable retouching, or a time span that cannot be established
evidence_requirements: at least one visible CONTENT image containing the concrete claim or visual demonstration
PRODUCT images are auxiliary comparison evidence only

no_physical_product_display.definition: After inspecting every CONTENT image, no recognizable physical product or real product use is shown.
positive_signals: camera promotion shows only captured effects or selfies without the camera
massage-device promotion shows only illustration or imagined use without the device
false_positive_boundaries: any CONTENT image with packaging, wearing, holding, installation, operation, application, illuminated or in use display counts as physical display
a small but recognizable physical product in any CONTENT image blocks the hit
evidence_requirements: all CONTENT images visible
at least one visible PRODUCT image

only_marketing_sales_pitches.definition: Nearly all meaningful content is price, discount, urgency, stock, gifting, or purchase pressure with no substantive product information.
positive_signals: buy one get one free or free-gift message dominates
price, discount, urgency, stock, gifting, or purchase pressure is nearly all meaningful content
false_positive_boundaries: any real function, material, size, compatibility, use, operation, or scenario information blocks the hit
bundle content or substantive visual demonstration blocks the hit
ordinary advertising copy does not outweigh substantive product information
evidence_requirements: all CONTENT images visible

description_not_detailed.definition: An ordinary product passes when it is clearly, completely, and recognizably displayed; only a visibly established supplement or health product may require understandable effect, ingredient, or usage explanation.
positive_signals: visible CONTENT establishes a supplement or health product, but shows only a package, name, or slogan with no understandable effect, ingredient, or usage explanation
false_positive_boundaries: an ordinary product that is clearly, completely, and recognizably displayed does not need extra material, size, fit, mechanism, or prose
an isolated packshot or PDP-like image alone is not a hit for an ordinary product
multi-angle display, real use scene, human demonstration, review, tutorial, function, ingredient, effect, or bundle information
evidence_requirements: all visible CONTENT images establish whether the item is a supplement or health product
do not infer product type from product title, category, country, or other forbidden inputs

aigc_authenticity.definition: Only a clear, localized AIGC-caused physical or structural defect in CONTENT.
positive_signals: anatomically impossible body structure, extra digits, missing digits, or impossible joints
fused limbs or impossible body connections
impossible physical interaction such as object penetration, floating, intersection, or impossible attachment
material structural identity change across images for the same visible person, object, or text
severe text or contour melting or obviously deformed object structure
false_positive_boundaries: AI-like appearance or a general impression that the image was generated
smooth skin, beauty retouching, polished commercial rendering, or illustration-like style
emoji, UI icon overlays, garment prints, stylized art, or other normal creative design
fantasy backgrounds or ordinary effect reinforcement
soft edges or unclear hand contours without a localized hard defect
minor appearance differences
general style variation across images without a material structural identity change
ordinary retouching, minor lighting, saturation, angle, composition, or background difference
minor blur, edge softness, weak or ambiguous anomaly, or vague unnaturalness without a localized hard defect
evidence_requirements: is_aigc=1 is an enablement gate only and is never visual evidence or a reason to lower the threshold
at least one visible CONTENT image
name the exact visible body part, object, text, or contour and describe the localized physical or structural defect
if the evidence can only be described as AI-like, smooth, rendered, stylized, inconsistent in style, or unnatural, do not hit

output_policy.final_label_problematic_when: ANALYZED has non-empty low_quality_issue_types, or PARTIAL_ANALYSIS has a supported LOW_QUALITY hit
output_policy.final_label_clean_when: ANALYZED has empty low_quality_issue_types, including monitor-only hits
output_policy.final_label_null_when: PARTIAL_ANALYSIS has no supported LOW_QUALITY hit or status is CONTENT_NOT_ANALYZABLE; use JSON null, never the string null
